# Breeze

Breeze is a project management software that helps teams plan, track, and collaborate on projects efficiently.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/breeze/.

## Actions

- **Add Project People**: Add people to a project.
- **Archive Project**: Archive a specific project.
- **Create Card**: Create a new card in a project.
- **Create Project**: Create a new project in breeze.
- **Create Workspace**: Create a new workspace.
- **CREATE_LIST**: Create a new list (stage) in a breeze project.
- **Delete Card**: Delete a specific card (task) by its id.
- **Delete Person from Project**: Delete a person from a project by user id.
- **Delete Project**: Delete a specific project by id.
- **Delete Workspace**: Delete a specific workspace by id.
- **Get Card** (read-only): Retrieve detailed info for a specific card (task) in a project.
- **Get Project** (read-only): Get a specific project by id.
- **Get Project People** (read-only): Get all users in a project.
- **Get Projects** (read-only): Get all active projects.
- **Get Workspace** (read-only): Get a specific workspace by id.
- **Get Workspaces** (read-only): Get all workspaces.
- **GET_CARDS** (read-only): Get all cards (tasks) for a specific project.
- **Move Card**: Move a card to a different stage or position.
